units.source_text: 阿泷家的庭院里有块种着大波斯菊的花圃。

en.t: In the courtyard of O-Taki's house, there was a flower bed planted with tall cosmos.

units.source_text: 这个花圃还圈上了竹篱笆，饲养着鸡。

en.t: The flower bed was also enclosed by a bamboo fence, and chickens were kept there.

units.source_text: 长长的花茎横七竖八地倾倒下来，沾满了泥土。

en.t: The long flower stems had fallen every which way and were covered with mud.

units.source_text: 这是孤零零的一间房子，处于村子的墓山到山谷的梯田中间，阳光充足，凉风习习。

en.t: It was a lonely little house, set between the village grave hill and the terraced fields in the valley, sunny and brushed by cool breezes.

units.source_text: 房后的竹林遮掩着草房的房顶，像游来游去的沙丁鱼群，婆娑多姿。

en.t: The bamboo grove behind the house hid the thatched roof, swaying gracefully like a school of sardines swimming back and forth.

units.source_text: 阿泷和她的母亲却从未听过竹叶摩擦的声音。

en.t: Yet O-Taki and her mother had never heard the sound of bamboo leaves rubbing together.
